title: Kotoba
brief: Kotoba (言葉, "words") is an open-source rich-text editor for Phoenix LiveView forms built on Lexical — formatting, code blocks, tables, file attachments, @-mentions, live collaboration with per-author undo, and safe HTML/text/Markdown rendering, with documents stored through a `Kotoba.Content` Ecto type. It ships as a prebuilt JS bundle in the Hex package so the app needs no Node.js; MIT-licensed, created 25 Sep 2026 (11 stars) — treat it as early-stage.
